EARLY.label: Early
EARLY.headline: You are in the exploration phase.
EARLY.body: The goal right now isn't to have the right answer. It's to gather data — about what energizes you, what drains you, and what you're willing to do when no one is watching. Commitments made now are experiments, not contracts.
advice: Try one thing this quarter that scares you a little.
Track what actually energizes you, not what looks good on paper.
Say yes to breadth. Depth comes later.

MID.label: Building
MID.headline: You are in the compounding phase.
MID.body: What you plant now has time to grow roots. The returns feel slow because they are slow — and that's exactly why they compound. This is the season to pick the few things worth going deep on and to stop apologizing for the things you leave behind.
advice: Pick one skill, one relationship, one asset. Go deeper, not wider.
Say no to three things that don't serve the long game.
Start something that won't pay off for five years.

PEAK.label: Peak Output
PEAK.headline: You are in the output phase.
PEAK.body: The world wants what you can produce. The risk isn't laziness — it's overextension. Everyone wants a piece of you. What you do now defines your reputation for the next decade. Protect the margins that make the output sustainable.
advice: Design your week around what only you can do.
Guard one day a week that is completely yours.

SENIOR.label: Harvest
SENIOR.headline: You are in the harvest phase.
SENIOR.body: Shift from doing to directing. From output to wisdom. The value you bring now isn't in the hours you log — it's in the judgment you've earned. The people around you need your perspective more than your labor.
advice: Trade one task for one mentee.
Say the long answer — people are listening now.
Let one thing go that you've been carrying for years.

ELDER.label: Legacy
ELDER.headline: You are in the legacy phase.
ELDER.body: Presence matters more than productivity. What you leave behind has already been planted. The work now is in how you show up — for the people who come after, and for the parts of yourself that are still growing.
advice: Write down one thing only you know.
Spend time with someone younger — as a peer, not a teacher.
Choose a small ritual to anchor your day.
